tweet_summary: A video presents a dramatic 'real incident' of a white husband shocked that his newborn twins are black, accusing his wife of cheating in a gynecology clinic.
why_note_decision: The clip is AI-generated entertainment/comedy, not a real event. Multiple fact-checkers (FACTLY, BOOM, The Quint, LatestLY, Yahoo) confirm it is AI-generated, originating from an 'entertainment' account; AI detectors score it ~98-100% synthetic. The post text frames it as a genuine hospital incident ('tension suddenly fills the room... his voice trembles with anger'), which is misleading given 7M+ impressions and the inflammatory racial premise. A note clarifying it is fabricated AI content is warranted. Many replies already call it AI, but the high-reach framing as real justifies a note.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the video is AI-generated / fabricated (a comedy or 'social experiment' skit), not a real hospital incident. It must NOT treat the event as real or speculate about genetics as if a real birth occurred. A note that merely says 'AI' without making clear it's not a documented real event is acceptable but weaker; the core required element is denying it depicts a real incident. Cite a fact-check (FACTLY / BOOM / The Quint) or note the source account is labeled entertainment.
reference_note: This post presents an AI-generated/fabricated video as if it depicts a real incident. Fact-checkers have investigated this viral clip and confirmed it is artificially generated content, not documentation of an actual hospital event. https://factly.in/video-of-a-white-woman-giving-birth-to-black-twins-is-ai-generated-and-not-a-real-incident/

fact_check.claim_verdict: False/fabricated: the video is AI-generated comedy/entertainment, not a real hospital incident.
fact_check.notes: Origin traced to AI/entertainment TikTok account (@br_ai_ded per fact-checks); detectors ~98.6-100% AI. The author's wall is full of similar AI videos (noted by a replier). The transcription's closing line 'Genetics can be surprising' confirms scripted skit content.

importance.lens_rationale: 7M+ impressions, 5M video views; an AI clip weaponizing a racialized infidelity trope spreads as 'real.' Correcting widely-believed inflammatory synthetic media has real value for the information ecosystem.
